name: DataHub
description: DataHub metadata/data-catalog platform. Runs via Docker Compose inside the LXC (GMS, Frontend, MySQL, Elasticsearch, Kafka) as no bare-metal install path is documented upstream.

notes.text: This app deviates from the usual bare-metal convention: DataHub only documents Docker Compose (dev/quickstart) or Kubernetes (production). This script installs Docker inside the LXC and runs the official quickstart Compose stack.
Not intended for production use as-is (same caveat as DataHub's own quickstart): default credentials, no auth on internal services, single-host only.
First start pulls several large images (GMS, Frontend, Elasticsearch, Kafka, MySQL) and can take several minutes before the UI becomes reachable.

Images are pinned to upstream's rolling 'quickstart' tag (DATAHUB_VERSION=quickstart in /opt/datahub/.env), not a fixed release - 'docker compose pull' on update follows whatever upstream currently ships there.
Default login: datahub / datahub. Change it before exposing this instance beyond your local network.
